title: Chettinad Chicken Curry
description: A fiery, deeply aromatic chicken curry from the Chettinad region of Tamil Nadu, built on a freshly ground roasted-spice masala with coconut, star anise and curry leaves.
steps: Dry roast the dried red chillies, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, peppercorns, cumin seeds, star anise and cinnamon in a pan over low heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Cool, then grind with the grated coconut and a splash of water to a smooth masala paste.
Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onions and curry leaves, and sauté until the onions turn golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1-2 minutes until the raw smell disappears.
Add the chopped tomatoes and turmeric, and cook until the tomatoes break down and the oil begins to separate.
Add the ground masala paste and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the raw spice smell is gone and the oil separates again.
Add the chicken pieces and salt, and coat well in the masala. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the gravy has thickened.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or dosa.
